VISUAL.description: Inspect the exact current-source CI preview in Day/Night at desktop and narrow widths. Verify theory/project association and native wrapping, unchanged 87% paper alpha/13% transparency and effective reading corners, and the same colored Writing formula visibly between the first and second book arches with coherent tilt, pulse and camera travel. Retain source/public identities and actual observations. Maintainer visual acceptance remains explicit; deterministic source assertions are not device or perceived-layout evidence. For the authorized Talks amendment, inspect the four distinct cards, concise context, truthful date/language/resource labels and native narrow wrapping at the same current preview; maintainer visual acceptance remains explicit.

EDITORIAL.description: Review the bounded original guest-source acquisition, exact canonical post identity, author/date and Matthew-to-Michael-Risch reshare chain against the new Home/Research wording. Distinguish the new commentary from older encouragement and preserve all unrelated responses; no scientific validation, adoption or institutional endorsement may be inferred. Record source/editorial review honestly against the exact candidate. For AC05, inspect all three original supplied public posts and bounded source records, verify PMDay and Betelgeuse are enriched without duplicate events and swarchua is distinct, and preserve exact Corning and prior sources. Distinguish event occurrence from source-post publication; do not infer spoken language, formal titles, recording playback or promised PMDay recording/slides from uninspected material. Record independent editorial/code review of the exact Talks candidate.

CURRENT-CI-REVIEW.description: Record exact linked Draft PR and Refs commits, current canonical/generated/offline and public artifact identities, passing applicable Basic/targeted/navigation/acceptance and normal preview CI, versioned source/review handoff and independent review. Reconcile actual issue checkboxes and the original acceptance intent from current-source evidence. Earlier runs, local preparation or self-review do not supply these decisions.

MERGE.description: Applicable maintainer decision and normal merge of the accepted candidate, followed by exact merged-source reconciliation before issue closure. Draft-PR preview and passing checks do not authorize stable staging, production activation or closure of broader issue41/issue45 criteria.
